refreshNotes: MY2026 Urus SE: carryover from MY25 with a modest price bump (KBB lists ~$280,736 starting vs ~$276,741 MY25). Same powertrain, same EPA numbers, same chassis. The MY26 Urus lineup in the US continues to offer Urus S (ICE), Urus SE (PHEV), and Urus Performante (ICE) — the SE is the only electrified trim. Sources: https://www.kbb.com/lamborghini/urus/ , https://www.edmunds.com/lamborghini/urus/
